description: Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # One selected item inside ComboboxChips. Rendered by the controller from
  # ComboboxChips' template; its text goes in the [data-text] span.
  class ComboboxChip < Base
    def initialize(show_remove: true, **)
      @show_remove = show_remove
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs) do
        span(data: {text: ""}, &)
        remove_button if @show_remove
      end
    end

    private

    def remove_button
      render Button.new(
        variant: :ghost, size: :xs, icon: true, tabindex: -1,
        class: "-ml-1 opacity-50 hover:opacity-100",
        aria: {label: "Remove"},
        data: {slot!: "combobox-chip-remove", action: "click->ruby-ui--combobox#removeChip"}
      ) do
        svg(
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
          fill: "none",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          stroke_width: "2",
          stroke_linecap: "round",
          stroke_linejoin: "round",
          aria_hidden: "true",
          class: "pointer-events-none"
        ) do |s|
          s.path(d: "M18 6 6 18")
          s.path(d: "m6 6 12 12")
        end
      end
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {slot: "combobox-chip"},
        class: [
          "flex h-[calc(--spacing(5.5))] w-fit items-center justify-center gap-1 rounded-sm bg-muted px-1.5",
          "text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-foreground has-data-[slot=combobox-chip-remove]:pr-0",
          "has-disabled:pointer-events-none has-disabled:cursor-not-allowed has-disabled:opacity-50"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The trigger of a multiple: combobox: one chip per selected item, then a
  # ComboboxChipsInput. The controller builds the chips from the checked items
  # with the template below; the popup is anchored to this box.
  #
  # max: (RubyUI extra) caps the chips: past it they collapse into a single
  # "<count> <term>" chip (term: from the root, "selected" without one) whose
  # remove button, like Backspace, clears the whole selection.
  class ComboboxChips < Base
    def initialize(show_remove: true, max: nil, **)
      @show_remove = show_remove
      @max = max
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs) do
        template(data: {ruby_ui__combobox_target: "chipTemplate"}) do
          render ComboboxChip.new(show_remove: @show_remove)
        end
        yield if block_given?
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "combobox-chips",
          ruby_ui__combobox_target: "chips",
          max: @max,
          action: "click->ruby-ui--combobox#focusInput"
        },
        class: [
          "flex min-h-9 flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent bg-clip-padding",
          "px-2.5 py-1.5 text-sm shadow-xs transition-[color,box-shadow] dark:bg-input/30 cursor-text",
          "focus-within:border-ring focus-within:ring-3 focus-within:ring-ring/50",
          "has-aria-invalid:border-destructive has-aria-invalid:ring-3 has-aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20",
          "dark:has-aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 dark:has-aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40",
          "has-data-[slot=combobox-chip]:px-1.5"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The text input after the chips. Backspace on an empty input removes the
  # last chip.
  class ComboboxChipsInput < Base
    include ComboboxContext

    def initialize(placeholder: nil, disabled: false, **)
      @placeholder = placeholder
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template
      input(**with_combobox_defaults(disabled: @disabled || !!combobox[:disabled], aria: {controls: combobox[:list_id]}))
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        type: "text",
        role: "combobox",
        placeholder: @placeholder,
        autocomplete: "off",
        autocorrect: "off",
        spellcheck: "false",
        autocapitalize: "none",
        aria: {autocomplete: "list", expanded: "false", haspopup: "listbox"},
        class: "min-w-16 flex-1 border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-sm outline-none ring-0 focus:ring-0 placeholder:text-muted-foreground disabled:cursor-not-allowed",
        data: {
          slot: "combobox-chip-input",
          ruby_ui__combobox_target: "input",
          action: "input->ruby-ui--combobox#filter keydown->ruby-ui--combobox#inputKeydown " \
            "click->ruby-ui--combobox#inputClick"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The popup. A native popover (top layer), positioned next to the trigger,
  # the input or the chips by Floating UI; side:/align: pick the placement,
  # side_offset:/align_offset: the gap, as in shadcn's ComboboxContent.
  class ComboboxContent < Base
    include ComboboxContext

    SIDES = %i[top right bottom left].freeze
    ALIGNS = %i[start center end].freeze

    def initialize(side: :bottom, side_offset: 6, align: :start, align_offset: 0, **)
      @side = SIDES.include?(side.to_sym) ? side.to_sym : :bottom
      @side_offset = side_offset
      @align = ALIGNS.include?(align.to_sym) ? align.to_sym : :start
      @align_offset = align_offset
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**with_combobox_defaults(id: combobox[:content_id], role: (combobox[:popup] == :dialog) ? "dialog" : nil), &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        popover: "manual",
        data: {
          slot: "combobox-content",
          ruby_ui__combobox_target: "content",
          closed: "",
          side: @side,
          align: @align,
          preferred_side: @side,
          side_offset: @side_offset,
          align_offset: @align_offset
        },
        class: [
          "group/combobox-content fixed inset-auto m-0 border-0 p-0",
          "bg-popover text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 rounded-md shadow-md overflow-hidden",
          "max-h-[min(--spacing(72),var(--available-height,100vh))] min-w-36",
          "w-(--anchor-width) max-w-(--available-width) min-w-[calc(var(--anchor-width)+--spacing(7))]",
          "data-[chips=true]:min-w-(--anchor-width) origin-(--transform-origin) duration-100",
          "data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95",
          "data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95 data-closed:fill-mode-forwards",
          "data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2",
          "data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2",
          "*:data-[slot=input-group]:m-1 *:data-[slot=input-group]:mb-0 *:data-[slot=input-group]:h-8",
          "*:data-[slot=input-group]:border-input/30 *:data-[slot=input-group]:bg-input/30",
          "*:data-[slot=input-group]:shadow-none"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Shared by the combobox parts: Base builds attrs in initialize, before the
  # Phlex context exists, so values that come from the root (ids, name,
  # multiple, disabled) are added while rendering. The caller's own attributes
  # still win.
  module ComboboxContext
    private

    def combobox = context[:ruby_ui_combobox] || {}

    def with_combobox_defaults(defaults)
      defaults.merge(attrs) { |_, ours, theirs| (ours.is_a?(Hash) && theirs.is_a?(Hash)) ? ours.merge(theirs) : theirs }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Shown by CSS while the controller marks the content data-empty (no item
  # matches the search).
  class ComboboxEmpty < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "status",
        aria: {live: "polite", atomic: "true"},
        data: {slot: "combobox-empty"},
        class: "hidden w-full justify-center py-2 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground group-data-empty/combobox-content:flex"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # A group of items, named by the ComboboxLabel inside it. The controller
  # hides it while none of its items matches the search.
  class ComboboxGroup < Base
    def initialize(id: nil, **)
      @id = id || "combobox-group-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
      super(id: @id, **)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_combobox_group]
      context[:ruby_ui_combobox_group] = {label_id: "#{@id}-label"}
      div(**attrs, &)
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_combobox_group] = previous
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "group",
        aria: {labelledby: "#{@id}-label"},
        data: {slot: "combobox-group", ruby_ui__combobox_target: "group"}
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The text input of a combobox, inside an input group (shadcn's ComboboxInput).
  # Outside ComboboxContent it is the trigger: typing filters and opens the list,
  # show_trigger: adds the chevron, show_clear: a button that clears the value.
  # Inside ComboboxContent it is the search field of the popup; pass
  # show_trigger: false there. Extra attributes go to the <input>.
  class ComboboxInput < Base
    include ComboboxContext

    INPUT_GROUP = [
      "group/input-group relative flex w-auto min-w-0 items-center outline-none",
      "h-9 rounded-md border border-input shadow-xs transition-[color,box-shadow] dark:bg-input/30",
      "has-[[data-slot=input-group-control]:focus-visible]:border-ring",
      "has-[[data-slot=input-group-control]:focus-visible]:ring-3",
      "has-[[data-slot=input-group-control]:focus-visible]:ring-ring/50",
      "has-[[data-slot][aria-invalid=true]]:border-destructive has-[[data-slot][aria-invalid=true]]:ring-3",
      "has-[[data-slot][aria-invalid=true]]:ring-destructive/20",
      "dark:has-[[data-slot][aria-invalid=true]]:ring-destructive/40",
      "in-data-[slot=combobox-content]:focus-within:border-inherit in-data-[slot=combobox-content]:focus-within:ring-0",
      "has-[>[data-align=inline-end]]:[&>input]:pr-1.5",
      "data-[disabled=true]:cursor-not-allowed"
    ].freeze

    ADDON = "order-last flex h-auto cursor-text items-center justify-center gap-2 py-1.5 pr-2 " \
      "text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground select-none has-[>button]:-mr-1 " \
      "group-data-[disabled=true]/input-group:opacity-50"

    ADDON_BUTTON = "size-6 rounded-[calc(var(--radius)-5px)] p-0 shadow-none"

    def initialize(placeholder: nil, show_trigger: true, show_clear: false, disabled: false, **)
      @placeholder = placeholder
      @show_trigger = show_trigger
      @show_clear = show_clear
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template
      @disabled ||= !!combobox[:disabled]
      div(class: INPUT_GROUP, role: "group", data: {slot: "input-group", disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)}) do
        input(**with_combobox_defaults(disabled: @disabled, aria: {controls: combobox[:list_id]}))
        addon
      end
    end

    private

    def addon
      div(class: ADDON, role: "group", data: {slot: "input-group-addon", align: "inline-end"}) do
        trigger_button if @show_trigger
        clear_button if @show_clear
      end
    end

    # Hidden while the clear button shows, as in shadcn.
    def trigger_button
      render Button.new(
        variant: :ghost, size: :xs, icon: true, disabled: @disabled, tabindex: -1,
        class: "#{ADDON_BUTTON} group-has-[[data-slot=combobox-clear]:not([hidden])]/input-group:hidden",
        aria: {label: "Toggle list"},
        data: {slot!: "input-group-button", action: "click->ruby-ui--combobox#toggle"}
      ) do
        icon("m6 9 6 6 6-6")
      end
    end

    # The controller shows it only while there is a value. It stays in the tab
    # order: it is the keyboard way to clear a single value.
    def clear_button
      render Button.new(
        variant: :ghost, size: :xs, icon: true, disabled: @disabled, hidden: true,
        class: ADDON_BUTTON,
        aria: {label: "Clear"},
        data: {slot!: "combobox-clear", ruby_ui__combobox_target: "clear", action: "click->ruby-ui--combobox#clear"}
      ) do
        icon("M18 6 6 18", "m6 6 12 12")
      end
    end

    def icon(*paths)
      svg(
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        aria_hidden: "true",
        class: "pointer-events-none size-4"
      ) { |s| paths.each { |d| s.path(d: d) } }
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        type: "text",
        role: "combobox",
        placeholder: @placeholder,
        autocomplete: "off",
        autocorrect: "off",
        spellcheck: "false",
        autocapitalize: "none",
        aria: {autocomplete: "list", expanded: "false", haspopup: "listbox"},
        class: [
          "h-full w-full min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-none border-0 bg-transparent px-2.5 py-1 text-base shadow-none",
          "border-input outline-none ring-0 focus:ring-0 focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 md:text-sm dark:bg-transparent",
          "placeholder:text-muted-foreground disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
        ],
        data: {
          slot: "input-group-control",
          ruby_ui__combobox_target: "input",
          action: "input->ruby-ui--combobox#filter keydown->ruby-ui--combobox#inputKeydown " \
            "click->ruby-ui--combobox#inputClick"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # An option. Its value travels in a native radio (or checkbox, when the root
  # is multiple:) named after the root's name:, kept visually hidden so forms,
  # required and FormField work without JavaScript glue. input: adds attributes
  # to that input (e.g. data: {value_missing: "..."}).
  class ComboboxItem < Base
    include ComboboxContext

    ITEM = [
      "group/combobox-item relative flex w-full cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm py-1.5 pr-8 pl-2",
      "text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
      "data-highlighted:bg-accent data-highlighted:text-accent-foreground",
      "not-data-[variant=destructive]:data-highlighted:**:text-accent-foreground",
      "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50",
      "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
    ].freeze

    def initialize(value:, selected: false, disabled: false, text: nil, input: {}, **)
      @value = value
      @selected = selected
      @disabled = disabled
      @text = text
      @input_attrs = input
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs) do
        native_input
        yield if block_given?
        indicator
      end
    end

    private

    def multiple? = !!combobox[:multiple]

    def native_input
      data = if multiple?
        {
          ruby_ui__checkbox_group_target: "checkbox",
          action: "change->ruby-ui--checkbox-group#onChange change->ruby-ui--form-field#onInput invalid->ruby-ui--form-field#onInvalid"
        }
      else
        {action: "change->ruby-ui--form-field#onInput invalid->ruby-ui--form-field#onInvalid"}
      end
      data[:ruby_ui__form_field_target] = "input"

      input(**mix({
        type: multiple? ? "checkbox" : "radio",
        name: combobox[:name],
        value: @value,
        checked: @selected,
        disabled: @disabled || combobox[:disabled],
        required: !multiple? && combobox[:required],
        tabindex: -1,
        aria: {hidden: "true"},
        class: "sr-only",
        data: data
      }, @input_attrs))
    end

    def indicator
      span(class: "pointer-events-none absolute right-2 hidden size-4 items-center justify-center group-aria-selected/combobox-item:flex", aria: {hidden: "true"}) do
        svg(
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
          fill: "none",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          stroke_width: "2",
          stroke_linecap: "round",
          stroke_linejoin: "round",
          aria_hidden: "true",
          class: "pointer-events-none size-4"
        ) { |s| s.path(d: "M20 6 9 17l-5-5") }
      end
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "option",
        aria: {selected: @selected.to_s, disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)},
        data: {
          slot: "combobox-item",
          ruby_ui__combobox_target: "item",
          value: @value,
          text: @text,
          disabled: (@disabled ? "" : nil),
          action: "click->ruby-ui--combobox#select pointermove->ruby-ui--combobox#hover"
        },
        class: ITEM
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class ComboboxLabel < Base
    def view_template(&)
      label_id = context[:ruby_ui_combobox_group]&.dig(:label_id)
      label_attrs = (label_id && !attrs[:id]) ? attrs.merge(id: label_id) : attrs
      div(**label_attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        # The group is named through aria-labelledby; the text itself is hidden.
        aria: {hidden: "true"},
        data: {slot: "combobox-label"},
        class: "px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class ComboboxList < Base
    include ComboboxContext

    def view_template(&)
      div(**with_combobox_defaults(id: combobox[:list_id], aria: {multiselectable: (combobox[:multiple] ? "true" : nil)}), &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "listbox",
        data: {
          slot: "combobox-list",
          ruby_ui__combobox_target: "list",
          # Clicking an option must not take focus away from the input.
          action: "mousedown->ruby-ui--combobox#keepFocus"
        },
        class: [
          "max-h-[min(calc(--spacing(72)---spacing(9)),calc(var(--available-height,100vh)---spacing(9)))]",
          "scroll-py-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain p-1 data-empty:p-0",
          "[scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # RubyUI extra (no shadcn counterpart): an option that selects or clears
  # every item of a multiple: combobox. Hidden while searching.
  class ComboboxToggleAll < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs) do
        yield if block_given?
        span(class: "pointer-events-none absolute right-2 hidden size-4 items-center justify-center group-aria-selected/combobox-item:flex", aria: {hidden: "true"}) do
          svg(
            xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
            viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
            fill: "none",
            stroke: "currentColor",
            stroke_width: "2",
            stroke_linecap: "round",
            stroke_linejoin: "round",
            aria_hidden: "true",
            class: "pointer-events-none size-4"
          ) { |s| s.path(d: "M20 6 9 17l-5-5") }
        end
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "option",
        aria: {selected: "false"},
        data: {
          slot: "combobox-item",
          ruby_ui__combobox_target: "toggleAll",
          action: "click->ruby-ui--combobox#select pointermove->ruby-ui--combobox#hover"
        },
        class: ComboboxItem::ITEM
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The button that opens the popup, for the "Combobox in Popup" pattern: put a
  # ComboboxValue inside it and a ComboboxInput inside ComboboxContent. It is a
  # RubyUI Button (variant: :outline) with role=combobox, like Base UI's
  # Combobox.Trigger rendered through shadcn's Button.
  class ComboboxTrigger < Base
    include ComboboxContext

    def view_template(&block)
      # The popup holds the search input, so it is a dialog (Base UI's role).
      combobox[:popup] = :dialog
      # aria-controls is set by the controller while the popup is open.
      render Button.new(variant: :outline, disabled: !!combobox[:disabled], **attrs) do
        yield if block
        chevron
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "combobox",
        class: "w-full justify-between font-normal",
        aria: {haspopup: "dialog", expanded: "false"},
        data: {
          ruby_ui__combobox_target: "trigger",
          action: "click->ruby-ui--combobox#toggle keydown->ruby-ui--combobox#triggerKeydown"
        }
      }
    end

    def chevron
      svg(
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        aria_hidden: "true",
        class: "pointer-events-none size-4 text-muted-foreground"
      ) { |s| s.path(d: "m6 9 6 6 6-6") }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Shows the selected item(s) inside ComboboxTrigger. The controller fills it:
  # the placeholder when nothing is selected, the item text, the texts joined
  # with ", " (multiple), or "<count> <term>" when the root has term:.
  class ComboboxValue < Base
    def initialize(placeholder: nil, **)
      @placeholder = placeholder
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template
      span(**attrs) { @placeholder }
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        class: "truncate data-placeholder:text-muted-foreground",
        data: {
          slot: "combobox-value",
          ruby_ui__combobox_target: "value",
          placeholder_text: @placeholder,
          placeholder: ""
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
Autocomplete input with a list of suggestions.

## Usage

### Basic

```ruby
div(class: "w-64") do
  Combobox(name: "framework") do
    ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Select a framework")
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No items found." }
      ComboboxList do
        ComboboxItem(value: "next") { "Next.js" }
        ComboboxItem(value: "sveltekit") { "SvelteKit" }
        ComboboxItem(value: "nuxt") { "Nuxt.js" }
        ComboboxItem(value: "remix") { "Remix" }
        ComboboxItem(value: "astro") { "Astro" }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### With clear button

```ruby
div(class: "w-64") do
  Combobox(name: "framework_clear") do
    ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Select a framework", show_clear: true)
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No items found." }
      ComboboxList do
        ComboboxItem(value: "next", selected: true) { "Next.js" }
        ComboboxItem(value: "sveltekit") { "SvelteKit" }
        ComboboxItem(value: "nuxt") { "Nuxt.js" }
        ComboboxItem(value: "remix") { "Remix" }
        ComboboxItem(value: "astro") { "Astro" }
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### With groups

```ruby
div(class: "w-64") do
  Combobox(name: "food") do
    ComboboxInput(placeholder: "Select a food")
    ComboboxContent do
      ComboboxEmpty { "No items found." }
      ComboboxList do
        ComboboxGroup do
          ComboboxLabel { "Fruits" }
          ComboboxItem(value: "apple") { "Apple" }
          ComboboxItem(value: "banana") { "Banana" }
        end
        ComboboxSeparator()
        ComboboxGroup do
          ComboboxLabel { "Vegetables" }
          ComboboxItem(value: "broccoli") { "Broccoli" }
```
